✦ COMBAT PUNCHY — 1.3.1 ✦

A clean offhand. A proper draw.

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge | Minecraft 1.20.1 · Forge

Offhand visibility

  • Fixed the permanent empty hand remaining visible while your offhand weapon was stowed on your back.
  • The entire stowed offhand now hides correctly, including skin, sleeves, armor and overlays.
  • Your offhand remains available immediately when fighting or actively using its item.

Equip animations

  • Added Punchy’s hand-out and hand-in animations when stowing and drawing your offhand weapon.
  • The back display waits for the lowering animation to finish, preventing duplicate weapon visuals.
  • Combat actions and active item use take priority over cosmetic equip animations.
  • Items remain in their original inventory slots throughout the transition.

Preserved automatic combat switching, the configurable seven-second inactivity timeout, back placement controls and per-item overrides.

Replace your previous Combat Punchy JAR. Keep your existing configuration.
